notes: Outflows are first-hop ZBCN transfers from each wallet, classified by destination; sends to known deposit relays count as CEX.
Reaching a sell venue is not proof of a market sale: it can be market making, OTC settlement or treasury operations.
Labels marked medium/low confidence come from this repo's own forensics, not from Zebec Network.
USD values use the price above and are rough.

Solana outflows are first-hop SPL transfers classified by owner. Swap proceeds and further hops for unlabelled recipients (WALLET_FLOWS_TRACE_DEPTH, default 1, max 2) are traced within a per-run call cap; large-seller and bot-cluster discovery are not run for this chain.
